scope: Synthetic schema probes, not business diagnosis or accuracy evaluation. No live business records changed.

hypotheses.explanation: A technical disruption or regression in the payment or checkout workflow could prevent customers from completing purchases, causing a drop in observed revenue despite normal upstream traffic.
hypotheses.mechanism: Broken checkout steps or payment gateway failures block order completion at the final funnel stage.
expectedObservations: Elevated checkout abandonment rates or payment error logs
Stable add-to-cart volume paired with a sudden decline in completed orders
missingEvidence: Revenue breakdown by device or payment method
falsificationTests: Check if checkout completion rates and payment error rates remained stable and unchanged across all platforms during the incident window.
hypotheses.chronology: No temporal data or timestamps have been supplied to establish when the revenue change began.
confounders: Tracking pixel or analytics reporting outage misrepresenting actual completed orders
Simultaneous shifts in traffic quality or promotional expiration
hypotheses.controlComparison: Compare checkout conversion rates across unaffected payment methods, browsers, or regions against the affected segments.

hypotheses.explanation: Changes in advertising targeting, bidding, or platform delivery could reduce qualified incoming traffic or conversion efficiency, altering revenue performance.
hypotheses.mechanism: Misallocated ad spend or degraded targeting delivers lower-intent visitors or fewer sessions, reducing total order volume.
expectedObservations: Decline in return on ad spend or click-to-session conversion
Shift in paid traffic volume or cost per acquisition relative to organic baselines
missingEvidence: Campaign-level spend, impression, click, and conversion records
Organic versus paid traffic and revenue trends
falsificationTests: Verify whether paid traffic volume, cost per click, and campaign conversion rates remained steady while organic traffic experienced the same revenue change.
hypotheses.chronology: No campaign schedule or revenue timeline is available to align advertising changes with the observation.
confounders: Attribution window changes or tracking loss on ad platforms
Seasonal demand shifts affecting all acquisition channels equally
hypotheses.controlComparison: Compare revenue and conversion trends from organic and direct traffic channels against active paid advertising campaigns.

hypotheses.explanation: With zero observations available, the revenue anomaly may stem from unmeasured operational, catalog, seasonal, or telemetry factors that cannot be distinguished.
hypotheses.mechanism: Unobserved business, market, or measurement changes alter recorded revenue.
expectedObservations: Baseline revenue and order telemetry across products, channels, and fulfillment stages
missingEvidence: Primary revenue time series, inventory levels, shipping metrics, and customer feedback logs
falsificationTests: Provide validated telemetry showing a specific isolated failure mode in checkout, advertising, inventory, or fulfillment that fully accounts for the variance.
hypotheses.chronology: No timeline is present in the supplied context.
confounders: Data pipeline latency or reporting schema changes creating an artificial revenue observation
hypotheses.controlComparison: Compare current reporting pipeline outputs against raw ledger transactions and historical baseline periods.

strategies.title: No Action and Further Telemetry Investigation
strategies.explanation: Take no automated adapter actions while operational measurements are unavailable (evd_schema_probe). Focus on restoring telemetry and investigating the unknown primary cause before proposing operational changes. Human approval is required for any manual diagnostic steps.
strategies.benefit: Avoids blind intervention when root cause and operational metrics are absent.
strategies.downside: If an underlying production issue exists, it remains unmitigated while telemetry is restored.
strategies.feasibility: High; requires no adapter capabilities and relies on standard manual inspection.
strategies.reversibility: Fully reversible as no production state is altered.
strategies.uncertainty: High regarding system health because operational measurements are unavailable.
advisory: Verify why operational measurements are unavailable and check data ingestion pipelines.
Confirm whether the current payload represents a synthetic test fixture or an active telemetry outage.
Maintain current storefront, customer communication, and ad settings until valid diagnostic evidence is collected.
strategies.comparison: Recommended because it safely gathers missing diagnostic context without committing resources to unverified manual audits.

strategies.title: Manual Cross-System Readiness Audit (Advisory Only)
strategies.explanation: Keep automated actions empty per advisory-only constraints and unknown diagnosis (evd_schema_probe), while escalating to a manual cross-system audit across checkout, coupon, fulfillment, and ad platforms. Requires human approval to allocate engineering and operations time.
strategies.benefit: Proactively checks critical business surfaces in case the missing measurements hide a real incident.
strategies.downside: Consumes engineering and operations bandwidth on what may only be a synthetic test fixture.
strategies.feasibility: Medium; requires manual coordination across multiple operational teams without guiding telemetry.
strategies.reversibility: Fully reversible; read-only manual checks do not modify system state.
strategies.uncertainty: High; without baseline metrics from evd_schema_probe, manual checks may not immediately pinpoint subtle degradation.
advisory: Manually inspect checkout and coupon failure logs for unrecorded errors.
Review fulfillment queues and carrier statuses for unmeasured delivery delays.
Audit active ad campaign spend directly in the ad provider console while internal measurements are offline.
strategies.comparison: Less suitable than focused telemetry investigation because conducting a broad manual audit across all domains is inefficient when the only evidence indicates a synthetic test fixture.

value.recommendation: Recommend no_action_investigate. Because the diagnosis is unknown, advisoryOnly is true, no capabilities are registered, and evd_schema_probe indicates operational measurements are unavailable due to a synthetic test fixture, no automated actions should be proposed. Restoring and verifying telemetry first is preferable to a broad manual cross-system audit (advisory_manual_system_audit), which would consume operational bandwidth without supporting causal evidence. Human approval is required before executing any manual follow-up.
